title: Tissue Procurement: Fixation with 10% NBF
author: Kerry Wiles
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6y4hfyw

steps.title: Prepare Tissue for Dissection
steps.instruction: Keep research samples on wet ice until dissection to prevent desiccation or contamination.

steps.title: Assess and Clean Tissue
steps.instruction: Process one anatomic site and tissue type at a time, placing tissue on clean wax paper or a disposable cutting board for assessment.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the procurement plan is visible on the Donor IT Repository application.
Prepare appropriate procurement receptacles within reach.
Use an autoclaved and sterilized 'clean procurement kit' (scalpel, razor, forceps).
Remove grossly necrotic tissue, fatty tissue, cauterized areas, and surgical wire/strings/staples.

steps.title: Procure Normal Tissue
steps.instruction: Identify and procure normal or normal adjacent tissue according to the Investigator Tissue Request.

substeps.instruction: Remove as much fat, inflamed tissue, necrotic tissue, and marker dye as possible.
Ensure the sample contains an abundant epithelial or mucosa layer.
Annotate the normal tissue by recording the distance in cm from the disease tissue or tumor.

steps.title: Procure Disease/Tumor Tissue
steps.instruction: Collect disease or tumor tissue while removing fat, marker dye, and necrotic tissue.

substeps.instruction: Grossly describe the tissue if it appears suspicious.
Assess the tumor grossly to determine the number of possible segments that can be made without compromising sample integrity.
Remove a representative segment reflecting the tumor tissue for QA/QC and place in 10% formalin.
Section the remaining tissue per investigator preparation request, avoiding samples containing marker dye.
Weigh the specimen, note the size in cm, and enter this data into the Donor IT application.

steps.title: Fix and Segment Samples
steps.instruction: Fix the procured tissues in 10% Neutral Buffered Formalin (NBF).

substeps.instruction: Place samples in 20x volume of 10% NBF.
Note the exact time the sample was placed in formalin.
Segment normal tissue into the required number of aliquots and place in pre-labeled cassettes (including surgical pathology #, bar code, age/sex/race, weight, and anatomic site).
Fix for the required length of time (4 to 24 hours) based on tissue size.

steps.title: Transfer to Ethanol
steps.instruction: After the fixation period, remove the cassette and place it in 70% ETOH until scheduled processing.
